notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant and Piggie book. Both Gerald (elephant) and Piggie are named distinctive characters requiring sourced clip art. The core theme is emotional support between friends — Piggie dresses up in costumes (cowboy, clown, robot) to cheer up sad Gerald. Key vocabulary centres on emotions (sad, happy, cry, laugh, surprise) and social interaction (friend, hug, cheer up, funny). 'Costume' is central to the plot. Piggie should be included in character_images_needed as a key secondary character who drives the action. Both characters appear extensively throughout the book.
